meta.source: Derived 2026-09-30 for the prediction-market-lab tracking page. Accent: indigo; ink is a hard dark shade of the accent hue; neutrals are blue-tinted. Chart palette validated for colour-vision separation on both surfaces.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. A faint vertical wash from surface to canvas is allowed; never a flat pure white page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, chart frames, table bodies, the app bar.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells, code blocks, the table header row. One step down from surface, never a beige.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and inputs. Dividers use separator as a breathing-edge gradient instead.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and focus borders, table rules that must read at a glance.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text. A hard dark shade of the accent hue, never neutral black. 13:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body text of lower rank: table cells, chart footnotes, the comparison line on a stat tile.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, axis labels, timestamps, empty-state copy. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and on sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one colour: links, the primary button, focus ring, the active model in the switcher, series 1. Used once per view or not at all.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of anything painted accent. One step along the ramp, never a new hue.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the active chip, hover wash on list items. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Breathing-edge dividers: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, separator 20%, separator 80%, transparent). Never an edge-to-edge line.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: The colour inside every box-shadow, tinted toward ink. Alpha stays at or under 0.12 in light.

tokens.name: reference
tokens.usage: Reference lines on charts: the 50% baseline, the backtest level. A grey that recedes behind every series.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1. Fixed order: 1 blue, 2 orange, 3 aqua, 4 yellow, 5 magenta, 6 green. Assigned by entity and never re-painted when a filter removes a series.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (orange).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (aqua). Below 3:1 on the light surface: always direct-labelled, never colour alone.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (yellow). Below 3:1 on the light surface: always direct-labelled.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (magenta). Below 3:1 on the light surface: always direct-labelled.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6 (green). The last slot; a seventh series folds into Other or becomes a small multiple.

tokens.name: interval-fill
tokens.usage: The 95% interval band around a cumulative accuracy line. Series colour at low alpha, no border.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: A model above its baseline with the interval clear of it. Always with the word beside it, never colour alone.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: A model whose interval includes the baseline. Always with the word.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: A model below its baseline, or a stale log. Always with the word.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and chart titles, left-aligned inside the frame.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Cumulative and rolling accuracy since the training cutoff
styles.usage: The line under a title, in text-secondary.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A window is fifteen minutes aligned to the quarter hour.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Controls, chips, the switcher, legend labels. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes under charts, axis titles, timestamps, in text-muted.

styles.name: numeral-lg
styles.usage: The value on a stat tile. Tabular numerals so tiles align.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Table cells, hover readouts, intervals. Right-aligned in tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid unit; gaps inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a control; between a value and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; legend item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; between tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and chart-frame padding; between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above the first section and below the last.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, table header corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Chart frames and cards. Children use md (concentric: parent radius minus padding).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The model switcher chips and the theme toggle.

tokens.name: shadow-resting
tokens.usage: Cards and chart frames at rest. One overhead light source; sharp close layer plus soft ambient.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the hover tooltip on a chart. Never on content cards.
